priorityList.notes: Bloodrage on cooldown: rage is the limiting resource, same as Fury.
Recklessness on cooldown: Arms has no Death Wish, so this is the burst cooldown.

Keep Rend up: Improved Rend and Deep Wounds both want the bleed ticking. Fix round 3: Rend's DoT lives on the target, not the warrior, so the gate is dotIsActive against the current target rather than auraIsActive against the caster -- the same shape shaman-elemental and druid-feral already use for their own DoT upkeep checks. The old auraIsActive gate never resolved (nil condition, read as always true), so Rend was recast on every free global.
Mortal Strike is the highest damage per rage button and comes off a six second cooldown.
Overpower is a bare cast: the engine's ExtraCastCondition only lets it land while the dodge-triggered proc aura is up, so it is a free line that falls through otherwise.
Heroic Strike as the rage dump, never below 40 rage.
